title: chore: delete the ovh text origin
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the legacy OVH text-origin app and VM routing after the text cache Worker had handled every request since 2026-10-12 12:55 UTC. Cache misses, uncached paths and /feed now go through origin(); the Worker configuration takes over text-origin.pollinations.ai as a custom domain, preserving the old hostname’s free limit and paywall, including its use in 402 resource.url responses. Removed proxyRequest, ADAPTER_SHARE, X-Legacy-Path, ORIGIN_HOST and the text VM test job. The remaining Worker tests pass: 69 tests, with four VM-path tests removed.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden-shed server room, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps a single glowing CRT terminal take over the sign for text-origin.pollinations.ai while vines curl around an unplugged old server; Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, small-to-medium sized and never oversized, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and lavender, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
